description: This file defines the SocketConnectionOptions class, which encapsulates configuration options for socket connections within the Orleans networking framework. It includes properties for I/O queue count, TCP options like NoDelay and KeepAlive, keep-alive timing, retry counts, and a memory pool factory.

classes.name: SocketConnectionOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for socket connections, including I/O queue count, TCP keep-alive settings, and memory pool factory.
